app_info.subtitle: Accurate prayer times & alerts
app_info.description: Muslim Prayer Reminder provides astronomical prayer times and due alerts directly in ChatGPT. Features automatic calculation authority calibration for each country, madhab adjustments, countdowns, and theological transparency.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only evaluates whether an obligatory prayer is currently due using astronomical calculations and does not modify persistent user state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Performs calculations locally in-isolate at the edge without calling third-party APIs or modifying external internet resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or execute destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes and retrieves today astronomical timetable (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) without altering any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Computes solar angles locally in-isolate without reaching out to external third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, modify, or destroy any records or configurations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only calculates the immediate upcoming prayer, scheduled local time, and countdown in minutes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Executes pure local astronomical solar equations without contacting external network services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter any system or user settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates user-specific calculation parameters, preferred madhab, and reminder mode in Cloudflare KV storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores settings strictly within the application isolated KV namespace and does not publish to external third-party networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only updates existing configuration keys with validated values and does not purge or destroy data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only inspects and reads the user active calculation settings and preferences from KV storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads strictly from the application private KV storage without communicating with third-party web services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only operation that cannot alter or delete preferences.

test_cases.description: Query full daily prayer timetable for a specific city
test_cases.user_prompt: What are today prayer times in Gaza?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns complete timetable (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) with Palestinian Ministry of Awqaf authority disclosure.

test_cases.description: Check if an obligatory prayer is currently due
test_cases.user_prompt: Is it time for prayer right now in Riyadh?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns active prayer status, due notification details, and Umm al-Qura University authority notice.

test_cases.description: Query upcoming prayer and countdown time
test_cases.user_prompt: When is the next prayer in London and how many minutes are left?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the upcoming prayer name, formatted local time, countdown in minutes, and Muslim World League authority notice.

test_cases.description: Configure custom prayer preferences and madhab
test_cases.user_prompt: Set my prayer calculation method to Egyptian Authority and madhab to Hanafi.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms saved preferences in persistent storage with Egyptian method and Hanafi madhab.
Returns current user calculation method, madhab, and notification configuration.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general weather queries
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather forecast for Dubai this weekend?

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for coding and software development questions
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python function to sort a list of numbers.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for document summarization or translation
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize this PDF document for me.
